name: Shira
title: Ephraim's Descendants and City Builder
summary: Shira was a woman from the tribe of Ephraim who built Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sherah. She is unusual in biblical material because she is one of very few women credited with founding cities. She is mentioned in the genealogy of Ephraim in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Ephraim's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Shira is mentioned as a descendant of Ephraim through the line of Beriah in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Founding of Lower Beth-Horon
keyEvents.description: Shira built Lower Beth-Horon, an important city located on the border between the territories of Ephraim and Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Founding of Upper Beth-Horon
keyEvents.description: Shira also built Upper Beth-Horon, which together with Lower Beth-Horon controlled a strategically important mountain pass.

keyEvents.title: Founding of Uzzen-Sherah
keyEvents.description: Shira founded the city of Uzzen-Sherah, a city that bears her own name, testifying to her significance and influence.

keyEvents.title: The Sorrow and Rebuilding of the Tribe of Ephraim
keyEvents.description: The context for Sheera's work is linked to Ephraim's grief after his sons were killed by men from Gath, and the subsequent rebuilding of the tribe.
